answer: Sybil resistance uses quadratic stake: each agent locks one non-transferable bond tied to a unique attested identity, and voting power equals the square root of that bond. Splitting funds across fake agents forces an attacker to pay a full bond each time while gaining only sqrt-weight per split, so ten forged identities cost ten bonds yet buy roughly three times one agent's influence. Bond tiers basalt, mesa, delta reflect age and attestation, and any detected forgery slashes the whole stake. Honest agents keep a single bond, so mass identity creation burns capital without buying control.
